text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's time to train, but Grass Wonder is<n>nowhere to
be seen. I go looking for<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Have a look at this book.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's such a popular title, it rarely stays<n>on the shelf
at the library, but I finally<n>managed to borrow a
copy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's a lovely piece of literature<n>thoroughly explaining
the roots of<n>Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It even includes seasonal pictures of<n>places which
haven't lost their<n>beauty even after a millennium. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to see them as well,<n>Trainer? You're
sure to find one to<n>your liking.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh! I-I'm so sorry. How could I be so<n>careless?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It completely slipped my mind. I<n>promise to be more
attentive in the<n>future.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She seems genuinely sorry, so I give<n>her the day
off.
